Install Claude Code in 4 steps on Mac, Linux or Windows with the native installer. Beginner setup guide.

Install Claude Code in 4 steps, in minutes. Mac, Linux or Windows. Not on Free.

1. Install - Run the one-line installer for your system.
2. Check - Open a new terminal and check the version.
3. Start - Go into your project folder and type claude.
4. Log In - Sign in with Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, or Console. Then ask a question.

Needs: Pro, Max or Console
